primary.title: FD details soon to be included in consolidated account statement: What it means for investors
primary.summary: The RBI's new initiative will soon allow investors to receive a comprehensive view of their bank deposits and investments in one statement. The implementation is expected by 31 December 31 2026. Here's what it means for you.
